def: A cross-domain text-to-SQL benchmark (Yu et al., 2018) of 10,181 questions and 5,693 SQL queries over 200 multi-table databases, testing generalization to unseen schemas.
practice: Its successor Spider 2.0 (2024) has 632 enterprise workflow tasks on Snowflake, BigQuery, SQLite and dbt projects with databases often over 1,000 columns, much closer to analyst-agent work than single-query parsing.
